hints.title: Greedy Optimism
hints.text: Greedily accept every transaction into the running balance.

hints.title: Heap Eviction
hints.text: When running balance drops below zero, retroactively remove the most negative debit accepted so far.

hints.title: Optimal Substructure
hints.text: Removing the largest magnitude deduction restores the balance maximally, keeping as many transactions as possible.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def maxTransactions(self, amounts: list[int]) -> int:
        running_sum = 0
        min_heap = [] # stores negative transactions taken
        count = 0
        for x in amounts:
            if x >= 0:
                running_sum += x
                count += 1
            else:
                running_sum += x
                count += 1
                heapq.heappush(min_heap, x)
                if running_sum < 0:
                    # Pop the most negative transaction to restore feasibility
                    worst = heapq.heappop(min_heap)
                    running_sum -= worst
                    count -= 1
        return count
```
